extension.source: https://github.com/xbmc/skin.estuary/ (Estuary, the base of this skin)
extension.summary: Live TV first: a channel grid home, slide-in channel list and a clear guide, built for a Raspberry Pi and a TV remote.
extension.description: Opens straight to your favourite, recently watched and all channels. OK while watching opens the channel list, holding OK shows programme info. Settings and add-ons keep the Estuary look this skin is based on.

extension.summary: Favourites and remote keys for the IPTV Control Room skin
extension.description: Keeps your favourite channels (hold OK or press red on a channel), lists them on the home screen with what is on now, and installs the remote key layout while the IPTV Control Room skin is active. Switching to another skin removes the key layout again.

extension.summary: IPTV Control Room skin and helper, with automatic updates
extension.description: Installs the IPTV Control Room live TV skin and keeps it up to date.
